Field.Label: Where is the Matter controller (matter-server) running? On this Mac, the plugin starts and manages it for you — there is nothing else to set up.
The plugin runs matter-server here on loopback (127.0.0.1:5580) and keeps it alive. No host or port to enter.
Node bin directory (optional):
Field.Description: Directory containing node/npx. Leave blank to auto-detect (Homebrew, then nvm, then PATH). nvm users can pin a version here, e.g. ~/.nvm/versions/node/v22.18.0/bin; Homebrew users normally leave it blank.

Field.Label: Primary network interface:
Field.Description: macOS interface matter-server uses for Matter/Thread discovery (e.g. en0).

Field.Label: Allow test/development device certificates:
Field.Description: Additionally trusts the Matter test-net DCL, so devices whose certificates chain to a test root are accepted — needed for dev bridges such as Homebridge. Production verification is unchanged. It also allows test-net OTA firmware to be offered to commissioned devices, so leave it off unless a commissioning attempt fails on device attestation, and untick it once that device is paired. Applies to the managed server on this Mac; takes effect when the plugin reloads, or via Plugins ▸ Matter ▸ Restart the Matter controller.

Field.Label: Hostname or IP only — no "http://" and no port here (e.g. 192.168.1.20). The remote matter-server must bind to a reachable address, not 127.0.0.1.
The Matter controller's control API (matter-server) is UNAUTHENTICATED. Only connect over a network you trust.
Enable Matter export
Field.Description: Publishes the devices listed in "Manage Matter Exports…" to Apple Home and other ecosystems. Unticking this stops the bridge and its accessories go unavailable — it does NOT unpair anything or delete accessories, so ticking it again brings them straight back. Nothing runs until at least one device is exported.

Field.Label: Bridge control port (loopback):
Field.Description: How the plugin talks to the bridge node. Loopback only — nothing outside this Mac can reach it. Change it only if something else already uses 5581.

Field.Label: Matter port:
Field.Description: The port ecosystems reach the bridge on. 5540 is the Matter default and is what Alexa expects; move it only if another Matter stack on this Mac (Homebridge 2.x, matterbridge, Home Assistant) already holds it — the bridge's log will say so. Changing it takes effect on the next plugin reload.

Field.Label: Fabric label:
Field.Description: How this Indigo controller is named on your Matter devices — it's what other ecosystems' apps show in their "connected services" / admin lists. Applied on every connect; renames existing devices too. Max 32 characters; blank resets to Indigo.
